_note: Story tree (doc/story_tree.md, src/sim/storydata.ts). enabled: false keeps the tree asleep in the game (the dev menu can wake it); tools/simStory.mjs always runs it. config: wmin = floor of a leaf's weight; wildChance = chance of a wild leaf at a knot; knotDelay / fruitDelay = days [least, most] between 'ready' and the event; tip = points for a ripe fruit, a fallen leaf and a dominant mark (the `dominant` highest marks); hardMul = weight of `hard` leaves by play mode; carry = share of stone-age deeds kept in the medieval age; oldTaleShare = share of a stone knot's effects when it fires as an old tale in the medieval age; secondShare = share of the second tip's legacy; resendDays = a scene that never came is sent again after this. trees: one per era; onePerTrunk = only the first knot of a trunk fires; tips: when a tip is scored ('eraEnd' = the day the era ends, a number = Nhà chung level).
